title: Output Schema for DeleteMessageBatch Operation
description: Output schema for the deleteMessageBatch operation in the connector.

payload.description: The main response payload from the deleteMessageBatch operation.

Successful.description: A list of entries for successfully deleted messages.

Id.description: The ID of the successfully deleted message.

Failed.description: A list of entries for messages that failed to be deleted.

Id.description: The ID of the message that failed to delete.

SenderFault.description: Indicates whether the error was on the sender's side.

operationSuccessful.description: Indicates whether the SQS API call was successful (does not mean all batch items succeeded).

requestId.description: The AWS request ID for the SQS operation.
